Formulae and know-how are of particular importance in the manufacture of a number of our proprietary products』=堀の源泉は特許でなく製法ノウハウ(プロセス知)であると自認。規制側も『We produce products which are required to be manufactured in conformity with current Good Manufacturing Practice ("cGMP") regulations as interpreted and enforced by the FDA』、SP部門は酸化エチレン(EtO)取扱いでEPA規制下(『regulate EtO or take other actions which could ultimately impact our business』)、『The Company's performance gases and chemicals are distributed worldwide in specially designed, reusable and recyclable drum and cylinder packaging, to assure compliance with safety, quality and environmental standards as outlined by the applicable regulatory agencies』、農業ミネラルは『The Company has a unique and patented two-step approach』(Metalosate)。ネットワーク効果(85)でもスイッチングコスト単独(75)でもブランド(55)でもなく、規制+プロセス知が第一の型→100。※ANH(売上22.3%)では『reputation for excellent product quality』とブランド寄りの記述もあるが従。出典 https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/9326/000000932626000007/bcpc-20251231.htm
